scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n hub,website,backoffice,tracker -c blue,cyan,magenta,green "npm run dev:hub" "npm run dev:website" "npm run dev:backoffice" "npm run dev:tracker"
scripts.build:apps: npm run build --prefix uis/website && npm run build --prefix uis/backoffice && npm run build --prefix uis/talent-pipeline-tracker
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n website,backoffice,tracker -c cyan,magenta,green "npm run start --prefix uis/website -- --port 3000" "npm run start --prefix uis/backoffice -- --port 3001" "npm run start --prefix uis/talent-pipeline-tracker -- --port 3002"
scripts.lint:apps: npm run lint --prefix uis/website && npm run lint --prefix uis/backoffice && npm run lint --prefix uis/talent-pipeline-tracker
